---
title: "Japan in Global Value Chains"
format: html
---

## Objectives
- Analyze the structure of Japan’s exports and imports.  
- Understand Japan’s integration in GVCs (automobiles, electronics, advanced manufacturing).  
- Identify Japan’s key trade partners and dependencies.  

## Key Concepts
- Export structure and comparative advantage.  
- Intra-industry vs inter-industry trade.  
- Japan’s trade balance with U.S., EU, China, ASEAN.  

## Readings (Suggested)
- WTO and JETRO-IDE (2011), Trade patterns and global value chains in East Asia: from trade in goods to trade in tasks.  
- Todo, Y., & Inoue, H. (2021). Geographic Diversification of the Supply Chains of Japanese Firms. Asian Economic Policy Review, 16(2), 304–322.

## Discussion Questions
1. How does Japan’s trade pattern reflect its industrial strengths?  
2. Which partners are most critical to Japan’s supply chain resilience?
